name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Stremio addon that merges addons, debrid services and Usenet into one filtered, sorted stream list, with a built-in web app.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard at /dashboard as admin with the password after the colon in the AIOSTREAMS_AUTH environment variable. Keep SECRET_KEY unchanged after the first start, or stored configurations can no longer be decrypted.
